CREATE TABLE "public"."stored_objects" (
  "bucket" text NOT NULL,
  "byte_size" int4 NOT NULL,
  "checksum_sha256" text NOT NULL,
  "completed_at" timestamp(3),
  "content_type" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "etag" text,
  "expires_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "file_name" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "object_key" text NOT NULL,
  "organization_id" text NOT NULL,
  "region_id" text NOT NULL,
  "state" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "uploader_user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "version_id" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "stored_object_completion_a37fde25" CHECK ((state = 'PENDING' AND completed_at IS NULL) OR (state = 'READY' AND completed_at IS NOT NULL AND etag IS NOT NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "stored_object_size_44a2044e" CHECK (byte_size > 0 AND byte_size <= 10485760),
  CONSTRAINT "stored_object_state_a37b3d27" CHECK (state IN ('PENDING', 'READY'))
)
